units.source_text: 夕雾大将用自己的车子载着儿子们，在明澄的月光之下回家。

en.t: General Yugiri took his sons in his own carriage and went home beneath the clear moonlight.

units.source_text: 在归途上，耳中仿佛还听到紫夫人的异常优美的筝声，觉得深可恋慕。

en.t: On the way back, it seemed to him that Lady Murasaki's extraordinarily beautiful koto still sounded in his ears, and he felt a deep longing for it.

units.source_text: 他自己的夫人云居雁也曾从已故的外祖母学琴，然而尚未学成，

en.t: His own wife, Kumoi no Kari, had also once studied the koto with her late grandmother, but before she had mastered it,

units.source_text: 就离开外祖母，迁居舅舅家里，不能继续学习。

en.t: she left her grandmother and moved into her uncle's house, so she could not continue her lessons.

units.source_text: 结婚之后，在丈夫面前怕难为情，绝不弹奏。

en.t: After her marriage, she was too embarrassed to play in front of her husband and never performed at all.

units.source_text: 只是对于无论何事，都很温厚周谨。

en.t: Still, in everything she did, she was gentle, kind, and very careful.

units.source_text: 后来连生二子，忙于抚育，便无余暇。

en.t: Later she gave birth to two sons in succession, and being busy raising them, she had no free time.

units.source_text: 因此一向缺乏风雅之趣。

en.t: For that reason, she had always been rather lacking in elegant artistic taste.

units.source_text: 然而善于嫉妒，其娇嗔之色，却也妩媚可爱。

en.t: Yet she was skilled at jealousy, and her pouting, coquettish expression was charming and lovable in its own way.
